palette._source: logo-purple.png (#522171, digital master) + Panago Ontario menu PL4, Oct 2026. Print render of the menu reads purple #5C2474, yellow #FCEC3A, mint #B4DDC1; use the digital values on screens.
palette._usage: Purple slanted band at the bottom of every piece; yellow display headlines on purple or terrazzo photos; mint and yellow starbursts for prices and NEW callouts; white for menus and price lists.

fonts._note: Google Fonts stand-ins for Panago's own faces: heavy rounded all-caps display, clean geometric sans body, marker script for small handwritten asides (as in the menu's 'All salads are entree sized'). Swap if head office supplies the brand fonts.

voice.tone: upbeat, plain, food-first; short punchy headlines in caps, then one plain sentence
proof_points: Plant-based options marked with a leaf
do: use real menu prices from the current Ontario menu, sizes as S 10" / M 12" / L 14" / XL 16"
say 'Taxes extra' or 'before 13% HST' wherever a price appears
point ordering to Panago 310-0001, panago.com or the Panago app
dont: price-gap claims against Uber Eats or DoorDash unless measured item by item
fake scarcity or countdowns that are not real
chance prizes that require a purchase (keep 'No purchase necessary')
show a pepperoni pizza as a veggie or paneer item

cta.scan: Scan to win! Spin free, every spin wins

compliance.disclaimer: Prices from the Ontario menu, October 2026. Taxes extra. Prices subject to change.
compliance.contest: No purchase necessary. One spin per person per day. Odds and full rules in the game. Draw winners answer a skill-testing question. (Competition Act s.74.06 + Criminal Code s.206)
compliance.casl: Marketing consent is a separate, unticked box naming Panago Gerrard & Bremner, Toronto, with unsubscribe in every message. Keep consent records 3 years.
compliance.franchise: Franchisee-run locally; head-office sign-off required for branded contests, store promo codes and the customer list.
